_about: Electrolyzer and fuel-cell runs pushed by the portal code of each era (E0 0ff614b, E1 3394d7b, E2 2902d1d, P1 b9cbe97) through its own main._run_job and _on_job_done, into an in-memory JSONBin. Sidecars are reduced to plot_type and metadata and stored decoded under "plots". Timestamps are from when the fixture was made, not the era's dates.
